title: TrustChain-Review: A Risk-Adaptive Blockchain and Game-Theoretic Framework for Trustworthy AI-Assisted Code Review
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and operational-cost evidence.
decision_rationale: Evaluates a risk-adaptive governance simulation for AI-assisted code review, including trust/detection outcomes and governance cost. It does not evaluate generated review comments directly, so it is supporting evidence only.

title: Rethinking Training Data for Generating Code Review Comments
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: generated review comments and dataset/context validity.
decision_rationale: Empirically analyses diff-comment training pairs for automated review-comment generation and derives a taxonomy covering semantic ambiguity, lack of actionability, and context dependence.

title: ALIBI: Adaptive Agentic Attacks on LLM-Based Vulnerability Detectors via Adversarial Code Comments
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: closely related security/static-analysis setting with a review-feedback connection.
decision_rationale: Demonstrates that adversarial natural-language source comments can mislead LLM vulnerability reviewers and evaluates defenses. Its artifact is a security detector rather than generated review comments.

title: Evaluating the Impact of Explainable AI on Trust in AI-Assisted Code Review
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: AI-assisted code review and reviewer trust/usefulness evaluation.
decision_rationale: Within-subject user study directly evaluates explanation level, trust, agreement with AI review recommendations, and review time for AI-assisted code review.

title: Cross-Model LLM Code Review: Should you use Claude to review Codex or vice versa?
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and operational-cost evidence.
decision_rationale: Controlled writer-reviewer experiment reports correctness, reviewer fixes and regressions, cost, and latency. The reviewer rewrites code rather than producing a review-comment artifact, so it is supporting workflow evidence.

title: Agentic Code Review in the Terminal: A Trajectory-Level Analysis of Behavior, Cost, and Human-Alignment
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: LLM-based code review and trade-off-aware evaluation.
decision_rationale: Empirically evaluates terminal-based agentic reviewers using a human-verified review dataset, review precision, repository-grounded trajectories, human alignment, and operational cost.

title: From Human-Centric to Agentic Code Review: The Impact of Different Generations of Generative AI Technology on Review Quality
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and reviewer burden/usefulness.
decision_rationale: Large-scale observational study of pull-request review across human, LLM-assisted, and agentic eras; reports efficiency and review-quality associations but does not evaluate generated comments as an artifact.

title: Evaluation Bias and Epistemic Inequality in Global Software Development
exact_criterion: Exclusion: no review-feedback connection.
decision_rationale: The study concerns regional evaluation bias in global software development. A code-review exercise is one assessment task, not the study's review-feedback artifact or evaluation target.

title: Self-Improving AI Coding Agents Through Accumulated Behavioral Rules: A Closed-Loop Framework
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: mitigation through human-feedback-derived rules in a code-review workflow.
decision_rationale: Reports a closed-loop process that converts accepted human review comments into persistent coding-agent rules and measures recurrence outcomes across recorded production sessions; it does not evaluate generated review comments directly.

title: Balancing Usefulness and Naturalness: An LLM-based Curation Pipeline for Code Review Comments
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: generated review comments, dataset validity, and mitigation trade-offs.
decision_rationale: Directly evaluates LLM-based curation of review-comment datasets across comment-quality dimensions, downstream comment generation and refinement, and the standardization-diversity trade-off.

title: Programmers Are Poor and Overconfident Judges of LLM-Generated Assertions
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and evaluator validity.
decision_rationale: Controlled human study measures programmers' accuracy and confidence when judging LLM-generated assertions and the effects of explanations. Assertions are adjacent reliability artifacts rather than review comments.

title: 3100 Opinions on Code Review in an AI World: Building Causal Theory from Practitioner Discourse
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and reviewer burden/usefulness.
decision_rationale: Systematically codes practitioner discourse to build a causal theory of how coding agents change code-review load, quality, comprehension, and human control. It provides contextual workflow evidence rather than comment-level performance evidence.

title: SWE-Review: Closing the Loop on Issue Resolution with Agentic Code Review
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: LLM-based code review, structured diagnoses, and end-to-end evaluation.
decision_rationale: Introduces and evaluates an agentic code-review framework that produces accept/request-changes decisions and structured diagnoses for AI-generated pull requests, including end-to-end issue-resolution outcomes.

title: Is Agentic Code Review Helpful? Mining Developers' Feedback to CodeRabbit Reviews in the Wild
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: generated review comments and usefulness/actionability evaluation.
decision_rationale: Large-scale field study of agentic pull-request review comments and developer feedback directly measures acceptance, discussion, rejection, and invalid-suggestion categories.

title: A Preliminary Study on Explaining Risk of Code Changes using LLM-Based Prediction Models
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: closely coupled review-workflow context and explanation evidence.
decision_rationale: Evaluates LLM-derived risk highlights for code changes as review guidance, balancing coverage of expert-labeled risky lines with review burden and latency. It does not generate review comments.

title: When AI Reviews Its Own Code: Recursive Self-Training Collapse in Code LLMs
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: mitigation through gating and verification in a code-review workflow.
decision_rationale: Empirically compares human-gate and AI-self-gate review filters in recursive code-model training, showing self-confirming approval can decouple acceptance from correctness. The evaluated artifact is generated code, not review comments.

title: Same Scrutiny, More Time: Eye Tracking Insights into Reviewing LLM-Labelled Code
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and reviewer burden/usefulness.
decision_rationale: Wizard-of-Oz eye-tracking study evaluates how an LLM-generated label affects developers' review attention, time, and strategies; it does not assess generated review feedback.

title: Assessing Language Models for Salient Class Identification
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: context and reviewability support in code review.
decision_rationale: Evaluates language models for identifying salient classes in multi-class commits, a review-navigation and context-selection aid rather than a review-comment generator.

title: SEVRA-BENCH: Social Engineering of Vulnerabilities in Review Agents
exact_criterion: Core inclusion: LLM-based code-review benchmark and adversarial evaluation.
decision_rationale: Introduces an adversarial pull-request benchmark that directly measures LLM review-agent approvals under narrative manipulation across security vulnerabilities.

title: Trust-Calibrated Code Review: A Participatory Design Study of Review Workflows for LLM-Generated Multi-File Changes
exact_criterion: Supporting inclusion: human-AI review workflow and trust calibration.
decision_rationale: Participatory design and survey study develops and evaluates workflow constructs for humans reviewing LLM-generated multi-file changes; it is not an evaluation of generated review comments.
